subject: Private Offer Approval Request — Orchid Analytics (AWS) — nonstandard rev-share & payment
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Deal Desk <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer — Orchid Analytics (AWS) — exec approval request

Hi team,

Orchid Analytics (Sanjay & Meera on cc) is asking for a private offer on AWS. Highlights:
- ARR profile: ~$1.1M first year, expected 35% YoY for 3 years.
- Request: 40% discount off list for first year, 6-month ramp rev-share (start 12% -> 18% after 6mo), and Net90 payment terms for the first contract year.
- Reason: They are a data platform for retail analytics and want to pilot in three enterprise customers before committing to a multi-year commitment. They will commit to a 12-month contract but need payment flexibility for Q1 spending cycles.

I attached the drafted private offer, security questionnaire, and a pricing workback. Legal redlines are minor (standard indemnities) but Finance flagged the Net90 + elevated discount as outside standard marketplace policy and asked for exec approval.

Asks:
1) Exec approval for a one-time Net90 for year 1 (Finance will require bank guarantee?)
2) Approval for the proposed discount and the staged rev-share change (we recommend limiting the rev-share uplift to 12 months).
3) If approved, I'll route the private offer to AWS Marketplace and initiate DocuSign.

Background: We need to move fast — they want to go-live with a private listing by 4/8 to align to their pilot schedule.

Thanks,
Rachel

--
Rachel Kim | Senior Account Executive

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer — Orchid Analytics (AWS) — exec approval request

Rachel / Marissa — thanks for the write up and the attachments. Quick thoughts after review:
- Discount: 40% is materially higher than our standard private-offer guidance at this ACV. I'd be comfortable approving a 30% list discount for year 1 as a cap if we can get a 12-month minimum commitment and commitment to a usage-based floor of $750k of monthly-min-equivalent usage across the pilot customers.
- Rev-share: staging the rev-share (12% -> 18%) is reasonable, but limit the uplift to be triggered by documented usage milestones (not time-only). Recommend: 12% base, 18% once cumulative billings > $300k.
- Net90: Finance will not approve Net90 without either an invoice guarantee (letter of credit) or a prepaid credit note for the first 45 days. If the buyer can provide an irrevocable bank guarantee we can consider Net90 for year 1.

If you want an exec to sign off I suggest we present two paths to Marissa: (A) Approve 30% + milestone rev-share + bank guarantee for Net90; (B) Approve 40% discount but require prepayment covering first 90 days and a 24-month minimum contract.

I've flagged risk level Medium-High because of the extended payment terms and the size of the discount.

Karthik
Director, Deal Desk
--
Karthik Iyer | Deal Desk Lead

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer — Orchid Analytics (AWS) — exec approval request

Thanks for the succinct summary. I reviewed the materials and agree with Karthik's framing. My conditional approval:
1) Discount: Approve up to 30% for year 1 only. Any request above 30% requires VP sales signoff and justification tied to a strategic initiative.
2) Rev-share: Approve the milestone-based increase (12% base to 18% once cumulative billings > $300k). Legal to codify milestone and reporting cadence.
3) Payment terms: Decline Net90 without guarantee. Approve Net60 if Orchid provides either an irrevocable bank guarantee or a prepaid credit for the first 60 days.
4) Contract term: Approve for a 12-month contract with an optional renewal clause. If Orchid pushes for Net90 and 40% discount, escalate to VP Sales (Markus Klein) for exceptional approval.

Operational requirements before go-live:
- Legal to sign off redlines and confirm milestone language.
- Finance to confirm billing workflow and whether AWS will permit the proposed rev-share staging on the private listing.
- Sales to document the commitment milestones in HubSpot (link provided).

Rachel: proceed to collect the bank guarantee / prepayment options and confirm with the buyer whether they can accept Net60 with guarantee. Loop Legal (irene_choi) and Finance (monica_patel) in parallel.

Marissa

--

Marissa / Karthik — thanks, that path is clear. Sanjay / Meera — per the note below, options are:
A) Provide an irrevocable bank guarantee covering first 60 days and we can move forward with Net60 + 30% discount and milestone-based rev-share (12% -> 18% at $300k cumulative billings).
B) If you cannot provide a bank guarantee, provide a prepaid credit covering the first 60 days (we can accept wire or AWS credit). In that case we'll proceed with the same price and milestones.

Please confirm which option you can provide by EOD Friday 3/19 so we can meet the 4/8 go-live target. I'll loop Legal and Finance once you confirm.

I'll update HubSpot with Marissa's approval decision and attach the signed offer once we have the guarantee/prepayment.

Thanks — rachel
